title: The Sleeping Visitor
author: Theo Joubert
blurb: Kestrel Sandoval, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
